content.text: Section 11 fully satisfies the rule, and Section 10 contains no data-withholding right.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: six months of transition assistance at Order Form rates (more favourable to us than "then-current rates"), return of all Customer Data within thirty days of request in a complete, commonly used, documented machine-readable format with metadata, and secure deletion after confirmed return with written officer certification, subject only to a legally required retained copy that stays protected and use-restricted. Section 11.2 expressly bars Vendor from withholding Customer Data over a fee dispute, and Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) creates no competing withholding or immediate-deletion right. No redline required.
